key_takeaways: Calm-hold + quarterly gate were tuned against quarterly-cadence backtests; live daemon runs daily checks but the strategy class (RobustQuarterlyStrategy) gates everything to quarter-ends.
Removing both filters produces +5.9% CAGR on 5y with SAME max drawdown.
Calm-hold's value is conditional on strategy design: helpful for narrow-universe Regime variant, harmful for broad-universe DM.
The April 2 2026 'quarterly cadence helped' conclusion was based on quarterly vs monthly comparison, not against daily — that conclusion is reversed under correct framework.
Production strategy should be: DualMomentumStrategy(no_tlt, 12m, switch_thr=0.02, no pilot) + orchestrator calm_threshold=0.0 (NOT RobustQuarterlyStrategy class).
